description: The embedding classifier takes the first shot at Model2Vec's trained label set, then Nebulento's fuzzy template matching mops up with runtime-registered templates and slot extraction — a padatious-free replacement candidate.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: m2v + nebulento is probably better than padatious. m2v-first (see sibling fighter) already showed an embedding-similarity front door changes what gets caught first, but it still leans on Padatious as the backstop, which means it inherits Padatious's two blockers to being a default: no slot extraction and no open-world runtime-registered intents. Nebulento fills both gaps — it extracts slots from its templates and accepts templates registered at runtime rather than only at training time — while still being a fuzzy/edit-distance matcher rather than a learned classifier, so pairing it with m2v's paraphrase-robust embedding similarity tests whether the combination can fully replace Padatious rather than merely front it. Comparators: padatious-stock (the plain baseline this fighter is trying to unseat) and the existing ensembles nebulatious and trident. REQUIRES ovos-m2v-pipeline>=0.9.0a1 — versions before 0.8.1a1 have a label-filter bug that poisons predictions; there is no plugin floor/pin field in this registry schema, so sweeps of this fighter must be run with that floor already installed in the runner environment.
